pages.text: $(l)Gaia's Wrath$() — the ultimate Botanical spell. Channels the devastating power of the Gaia Guardian in a massive AoE attack.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() 10$(br)$(l)Type:$() Legendary AoE$(br)$(l)Cooldown:$() 180 seconds$(br)$(l)Botania Mana Cost:$() 150,000 + 50,000/level$(br2)Applies Wither and Weakness to all enemies in range. Reaches full power only in the Alfheim dimension. This spell requires endgame resources to craft.

pages.title: Scribing the Scroll
pages.text: Scrolls are not crafted at a table. Set a $(l)Scroll Forge$() with $(l)Legendary Ink$() and a Botany focus — a $(l)Spell Petal$(), a $(l)Botanical Focus$(), or any item tagged $(t)#ironsbotany:focus/botany$() — then choose $(l)Gaia's Wrath$() from the spell list.$(br2)The ink rarity sets the highest spell level the forge will scribe, so richer ink is the only way to reach the upper levels of this spell.
